mapper.sql: p.param_id, p.plant_cd, p.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.proc_type, i.unit_cd, trim_scale(p.safety_qty)::text as safety_qty, p.lot_rule, trim_scale(p.lot_qty)::text as lot_qty, trim_scale(p.lot_mult)::text as lot_mult, p.make_lead_days, p.fence_days, p.remark, p.use_yn, p.row_ver, p.updated_at, p.updated_by
mapper.select:
select
order by
p.plant_cd desc i.item_nm desc i.proc_type desc p.updated_at desc i.item_cd desc ,
p.param_id limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select item_id, item_cd, unit_cd, proc_type, use_yn from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd}
select p.plant_cd, p.plant_nm, p.time_zone, p.sort_no, p.use_yn, p.row_ver from sys_plant p where p.use_yn = 'Y' order by p.sort_no, p.plant_cd
select use_yn from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd}

insert into aps_item_param (comp_cd, plant_cd, item_id, safety_qty, lot_rule, lot_qty, lot_mult, make_lead_days, fence_days, remark, use_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{v.plantCd}, #{v.itemId}, #{v.safetyQty}, #{v.lotRule}, #{v.lotQty}, #{v.lotMult}, #{v.makeLeadDays}, #{v.fenceDays}, #{v.remark}, #{v.useYn}, #{by}, #{by}) returning param_id
